resources.string: Helpful actions for copied content, headphones and screen use
Suggestions appear when useful. Tap an action to accept it or dismiss it. Content recognition stays on this device.
Suggest apps for shopping, video, social and cloud links, including Taobao share tokens.
Offer a browser action when no matching app is available.
Recognize copied tracking numbers. Open the tracking website only when you tap the suggestion.
Suggest your chosen app when headphones connect and music is idle.
Offer to turn off the flashlight after 15 seconds.
When you touch a dimmed screen, offer to keep it on until manual screen-off. End it from the notification at any time.

Inspired by AviumUseful © 2025–2026 The AviumUI Project (Apache 2.0). ArkUI native integration and changes © 2026 The ArkUI Project. Suggestions never open apps or upload copied content automatically.
Recognize verification codes locally and tap to copy
Incoming SMS messages with verification-code wording can offer a copy action. Suggestions stay hidden while the screen is locked and expire automatically.
Clear it after 2 minutes if the clipboard still contains that copied code. Other copied content is kept.
Follow music lyrics and adjust their appearance

Follow lyrics supplied by the active player, including timed LRC and Bluetooth lyric titles. Enable Bluetooth/car lyrics in compatible players. Lyrics hide on pause and give calls, recording and system indicators priority.
Show media title when lyrics are unavailable
Also supports players that send each lyric line as the Bluetooth media title.

Adapted from AviumLyricBarCore © 2026 The AviumUI Project (Apache 2.0). ArkUI native rendering and local timing © 2026 The ArkUI Project. Lyrics are provided by the player; rights remain with their authors and providers.
